# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Only the latest release of `zettel-lint` receives security updates.

| Version            | Supported          |
| ------------------ | ------------------ |
| 0.13.14 (latest)   | :white_check_mark: |
| All other versions | :x:              |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability within `zettel-lint`, please report it privately:

1. Use **Report a vulnerability** under **Security > Advisories** when enabled.
2. Otherwise, contact the repository maintainer privately on GitHub.

Please do not disclose vulnerabilities publicly in issues or pull requests until a patch has been released. We aim to acknowledge reports within 48 hours and provide updates on resolution status.
